tab.ignoredChars: Some symbols in the tab weren't recognized and were left out.

tab.badExtension: That file isn't a Guitar Pro file (.gp3/.gp4/.gp5/.gpx/.gp). Paste plain text or drop a file with one of those extensions.

camera.title: Check your fingering
camera.intro: Point the camera at the neck, calibrate once and make the chord: you'll see where each finger is and where the diagram puts it.
camera.privacy: The video is processed in your browser and is never sent or saved.
camera.placement: Point the camera at your guitar with fret {fret} in view and good lighting.
camera.denied: Couldn't access the camera. Check the browser's permissions for this site.
camera.unavailable: No camera was found on this device.
camera.precisionLoading: Downloading the high-precision model… using normal in the meantime.
camera.precisionFailed: High precision couldn't load; staying on normal.
camera.calNutFirst: click the nut (the piece where the strings leave the headstock), right where one of the outer strings crosses it
camera.calNutSecond: now where the other outer string crosses it
camera.calFretFirst: click the wire of fret {fret}, just past {dots} (toward the body), where one of the outer strings crosses it
camera.calFretSecond: now where the other outer string crosses it
camera.calError.degenerate: Some points repeat or sit on a straight line. Calibrate again.
camera.calError.shape: Those four points don't make a neck (the shape is twisted or crossed). Calibrate again.
camera.calError.proportion: The proportions don't match a neck: check that the first two clicks are on the nut and the last two on the chosen fret.
camera.refinerFailed: The fingertip correction couldn't load, so readings will be less precise. Reload the page to try again.
camera.lost: Lost the neck: put it back where it was (it picks it up on its own; if not, press "Measure frets") or recalibrate.
camera.fretsWaiting: Take your hand off the neck for a moment to measure the frets…
camera.fretsMeasured: Frets measured: {found} of {total}. The rest are filled in from them.
camera.fretsModel: The frets couldn't be measured in this light; using the calculated ones.
camera.calibrateFirst: Calibrate the neck to compare your fingers with the chord.
camera.barre: barre on fret {fret}, strings {from} to {to} (fingertip on the {from}th)
camera.allInPlace: Every finger is where the diagram puts it.
camera.noChords: Type at least one chord from the library to check it with the camera.
camera.desktopOnly: The camera check works on a computer with a webcam.
camera.desktopOnlyWhy: On a phone the camera lags, the calibration points are too small to tap precisely, and it's nearly impossible to keep the phone still while tapping it. Open it on a computer, with the camera pointed at the neck.
tab.recordLink: Or play it: listen and write
record.title: Listen and write
record.intro: Play a melody or a riff, one note at a time. PlainChord listens and writes the tab.
record.noNotes: No notes were heard. Get closer to the microphone, play one note at a time and try again.
playAlong.noChords: Type at least one chord from the library to play along.
landing.title: Guitar chords for people just starting out.
landing.subtitle: Type your song's chords to see where your fingers go and which change will be hardest. 28 chords and 12 symbols explained, free and without an account.
landing.leftOutBody: None of this helps you play better, so it isn't here.
landing.pathTitle: Five steps to your first song
landing.pathIntro: A suggested order, not a course. Skip what you already know: nobody is keeping score.
landing.step1Body: Open the tuner from the menu and play a string. It tells you if it's flat, sharp or in tune.
landing.step2Body: Type the chords separated by spaces and each one's diagram appears.
landing.step3Body: Every change between two chords is easy, medium or hard, the same for everyone.
landing.step4Body: Each chord is marked when it sounds right and the next one lights up. No score.
landing.step5Body: Paste the text or open a Guitar Pro file. Tap a symbol to see how it's played.
landing.closeTitle: The chord library, free and without an account
landing.closeBody: 28 chords with their fingering and the difficulty of every change.

guide.fig.partsAlt: An acoustic guitar lying on its side, headstock on the left and body on the right. The headstock, tuning pegs, nut, neck, frets, body, soundhole and bridge are labeled.
guide.fig.stringsCaption: With the guitar in playing position: the 6th on top, the 1st at the bottom.
guide.fig.stringsAlt: The six strings from top to bottom, thickest to thinnest: 6th low E (Mi), 5th A (La), 4th D (Re), 3rd G (Sol), 2nd B (Si) and 1st high E (Mi).
guide.fig.fretsAlt: A stretch of the neck with the nut on the left and frets 1 to 4 numbered. A dot marks a finger at fret 3, right against the bar on the body side.
guide.fig.handCaption: The fretting hand: your left if you play right-handed.
guide.fig.handAlt: A left hand seen from the back, fingers numbered: index 1, middle 2, ring 3, pinky 4, and the thumb marked T.
guide.fig.diagramView: In the diagram: the 6th on the left
guide.fig.rotate: Stood up and facing you, like hanging on a wall
guide.fig.orientationAlt: On the left, the neck lying down as you see it while playing, with the 6th string on top. On the right, the same neck standing up, as a diagram draws it, with the 6th string on the left.
guide.fig.tabCaption: The 1st string (e) on top, the 6th (E) at the bottom.
